text.en: Sustained damage with this weapon envelops the target in a field that weakens and stuns them. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

Instrinsically <overload/>Anti-Overload. 

Deals 50% less damage than Legendary Trace Rifles.

Dealing <pve 14 /> <pvp [5] /> hits within 0.15 seconds of each creates a 'Vex Cage' around the target for 1.25 seconds. At maximum fire rate, this cage forms in 0.93 seconds.

Maintaining the cage does not require continuous fire.

Targets within a Vex Cage recieve 15% increased damage from all sources (30% for Divinity). For sources that can deal precision damage, any damage dealt to a Vex Cage is treated as a Precision Hit.
